instructions: Template for a Node.js repository with docs/specs/export.md, the named source layout, and an existing in-process test harness. Adapt paths and commands before running.
The specification is already approved. Shared dependency or lockfile changes are outside this job; report them as blockers.
Each check must finish and clean up its own fixtures; no persistent server or production service is required.

tasks.task: Read docs/specs/export.md and map the existing API, CLI, contracts, and test harness for exporting audit events. Identify established authorization and pagination conventions.
acceptance: Cite the requirement IDs, existing interfaces, and test entry points.
Identify ambiguities that prevent implementation; do not invent requirements.

tasks.task: Implement the export contract from docs/specs/export.md: request validation, cursor and error shapes, and compatibility notes. Preserve existing interfaces. Use the map to locate conventions.
acceptance: Contract tests cover malformed cursors, unsupported formats, and stable pagination fields.
Document how API and CLI consume the same contract and preserve existing behavior.
instructions: Requested check (coordinator decides when to run it): {"id":"contract","argv":["node","--test","test/contracts/export.test.mjs"],"timeoutMs":180000}
Assigned file responsibility: src/contracts/export, test/contracts/export.test.mjs, docs/contracts/export.md. Preserve unrelated work.

tasks.task: Review the export contract against docs/specs/export.md and the map. Check compatibility, authorization boundaries, and whether API and CLI can implement it without guessing.
acceptance: Cite concrete defects by file and line and identify the failing scenario.
Approve only when the assigned change meets its acceptance criteria and its available check evidence supports it.

tasks.task: Implement the audit export API against the reviewed contract and docs/specs/export.md. Add focused tests using the existing in-process server harness.
acceptance: Enforce tenant authorization and cursor validation; no cross-tenant records can be exported.
Pagination is deterministic and failures follow the shared contract.
instructions: Requested check (coordinator decides when to run it): {"id":"api","argv":["node","--test","test/api/export.test.mjs"],"timeoutMs":180000}
Assigned file responsibility: src/api/export, test/api/export.test.mjs. Preserve unrelated work.

tasks.task: Implement the audit export CLI against the reviewed contract. Use a stub transport for focused tests so this branch does not require the API branch.
acceptance: CLI follows pagination, writes the selected format, and reports errors with a nonzero exit code.
Tests cover empty results, multiple pages, and interrupted transport without claiming live API verification.
instructions: Requested check (coordinator decides when to run it): {"id":"cli","argv":["node","--test","test/cli/export.test.mjs"],"timeoutMs":180000}
Assigned file responsibility: src/cli/export, test/cli/export.test.mjs. Preserve unrelated work.

tasks.task: Independently author test/scenarios/export.test.mjs from docs/specs/export.md and the reviewed contract, using the existing scenario harness. Exercise the public CLI-to-API path when both branches are composed. Do not implement production code.
acceptance: Scenarios cover multiple pages, empty exports, cross-tenant access denial, malformed cursors, and transport failure.
Expected results come from the specification; no skipped tests or assertions weakened to accommodate an implementation.
Report that the syntax check does not establish end-to-end behavior; behavioral execution belongs to assemble.

tasks.task: Review API behavior, tenant isolation, pagination, and regression tests against the shared contract.
acceptance: Cite concrete defects by file and line and identify the failing scenario.
Approve only when the assigned change meets its acceptance criteria and its available check evidence supports it.

tasks.task: Review CLI output, error handling, pagination, and transport-stub tests against the shared contract.
acceptance: Cite concrete defects by file and line and identify the failing scenario.
Approve only when the assigned change meets its acceptance criteria and its available check evidence supports it.

tasks.task: Review requirement coverage and whether scenarios can detect an incorrect implementation. Check harness usage; do not equate syntax validation with passing scenarios.
acceptance: Cite concrete defects by file and line and identify the failing scenario.

tasks.task: In the composed worktree, add test/integration/export.test.mjs for CLI/API compatibility using the existing harness. Execute the independently authored scenarios unchanged. If production code or those scenarios need repair, report the failing case to the coordinator.
acceptance: The complete CLI-to-API export path passes the scenario suite.
Integration assertions exercise the real composed modules and cover their shared cursor and error contract.
Changes remain in the owned integration test; report failures outside that scope.
